HI,

To save the summarized data to a csv you need to save the individual data tables in the list (i.e., the FeatureLevelData and ProteinLevelData objects).

In the `dataProcessPlots` function, can you try to pass the address=FALSE parameter? This should pop up the plot in Rstudio directly. I am wondering if this might show the labels.

Devon
